slides.title: AI-Enabled
slides.narration: AI-Enabled is the earliest stage of maturity. The company has already adopted AI tools, but uses them on top of its existing management architecture. Processes, roles, and decision-making logic stay the same, while AI becomes just an add-on: it answers questions, prepares data, and improves individual operations. The human role does not change — people work as before, and AI simply speeds up familiar tasks. That is why most companies get stuck here: the tools have arrived, but the way of working has not. The good news: you have already taken the first step. What matters next is not adding new tools, but mapping out a strategy for moving to the AI-Driven level, where AI is built into processes and makes forecasts on its own. Start simple: choose the processes you will strengthen first.

slides.title: AI-Driven
slides.narration: AI-Driven is the level where artificial intelligence is already built into your processes, but remains a tool in human hands. It analyzes data, builds forecasts, suggests decisions, and takes over some of the routine work. Unlike AI-Enabled, where AI worked on top of the old architecture, here it amplifies your every action. But final decisions and responsibility still rest with you: AI suggests, and you choose. This is a strong position — and a point of growth. The next level, AI-First, begins when AI starts acting on its own, and you become a manager of AI agents. To get there, map out a strategy: which processes to hand over to AI, and how to redesign roles around that.

slides.title: AI-First
slides.narration: AI-First is where artificial intelligence stops being an assistant and becomes part of the operating model. It acts on its own: it runs processes, assigns tasks, coordinates with other AI agents, and maintains consistent quality. The human role truly changes — you become a manager of AI agents: you set goals, design processes, review results, and train the system on your own data. Few companies reach this level. One step remains — AI-Native, where AI becomes the very essence of the business. Map out a strategy: where AI can do more than execute and actually create value, and how to build it into the core of your product.

slides.title: AI-Native
slides.narration: AI-Native is the summit. Here artificial intelligence is no longer a tool or an operating model — it is the very essence of the business. You do not just use AI — you create it. The product, the infrastructure, the business model, the entire value chain are built around AI. Your role is no longer operator or manager, but architect: you design systems that learn and create value on their own. This is a different type of organization, where the ability to create and scale AI is the main asset. There is no next level, but there is a new challenge: holding on to leadership. Build your strategy to set industry standards, not to chase them.
